title: Antibiotic Resistance of P. aeruginosa from the Buriganga River
description: Antibiotic susceptibility test results of 50 Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from surface water at seven sites along the Buriganga River, Bangladesh, tested against nine antibiotics by disc diffusion, with a summary per isolate and the zone diameter breakpoints used. The data are republished from the supplementary tables of Sharif, Amin, Mehbub and Ratul (2024) <doi:10.2166/wh.2024.270>, Journal of Water and Health, CC BY 4.0.
